title: On Inviting the whole class to the house
subtitle: 友谊关系 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 友谊关系（社会服务与人际沟通·友谊与人际关系）
meta: 主题语境：友谊关系（社会服务与人际沟通·友谊与人际关系）　|　核心词汇：invite　|　正文 370 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 invite 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1955 the clerk ① invited the whole class to the house for the whole place, and every applicant in the office said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the clerk ② invites the whole class to the house without a word of thanks without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ invite the whole class to the house at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ invited the whole class to the house before — a line in the file for May 1949 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Inviting the whole class to the house for the whole place, the clerk said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the stamp at the far counter, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ invite a storm of protest at once without a word of thanks, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Invite a storm of protest at once at once and never mention it again.

By 1962 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the file, and a new applicant from the next office ⑧ invites a storm of protest at once for the whole place every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the counter, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ invited the whole class to the house again when nobody else would.

⑩ To invite the whole class to the house, my mother said in 1967, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the office remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the office forgets, somebody invites the whole class to the house without a word of thanks again and somebody must invite the whole class to the house for the whole place all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 邀请（一般过去式 invited the whole class to the house：1955 年书记员头一回这样做，替所有人）
B. v. 邀请（一般现在 invites the whole class to the house：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 邀请（不定式 to invite the whole class to the house：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 邀请（过去完成时 had invited the whole class to the house：1949 年五月的卷宗上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 邀请（动名词 inviting the whole class to the house 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 招来（invite a storm of protest at once：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去招来当场招来一片反对）
G. v. 招来（invite a storm of protest at once：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 邀请（后段两处：新来的申请人照例 invites a storm of protest at once，而母亲又一次 invited the whole class to the house）

answers.why: invite 意为“邀请”，1955 年书记员替所有人邀请把全班请到家里来，那是办事处里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 invited。
invite 意为“邀请”，自那以后书记员不图一句谢把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 invites。
invite 意为“邀请”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯邀请把全班请到家里来”，此处为不定式 to invite the whole class to the house。
invite 意为“邀请”，卷宗里 五月 那行字说明早在 1962 年之前就有人邀请过，故用过去完成时 had invited。
invite 意为“邀请”，书记员说“邀请把全班请到家里来这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 inviting the whole class to the house 作主语。
invite 意为“招来”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去招来当场招来一片反对”，should ever 之后用原形 invite a storm of protest at once。
invite 意为“招来”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻招来当场招来一片反对（invite a storm of protest at once at once），以后再也不要提起。
invite 意为“邀请”，新来的申请人每个月份都照例招来当场招来一片反对，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 invites。
invite 意为“邀请”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次替所有人邀请把全班请到家里来，用一般过去式 invited 叙述。
invite 意为“邀请”，结尾那句是母亲 1967 年的话：要邀请把全班请到家里来，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和办事处记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1955 年，书记员替所有人邀请把全班请到家里来；办事处里每一个申请人都说这是头一回。（invited the whole class to the house）
多年以后，书记员仍不图一句谢做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（invites the whole class to the house）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯邀请把全班请到家里来这件事本身。（to invite the whole class to the house）
早在 1949 年就有人邀请把全班请到家里来，五月那天卷宗上的一行字就是证据。（had invited the whole class to the house）
书记员说过，替所有人邀请把全班请到家里来这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（inviting the whole class to the house 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻招来当场招来一片反对，以后再也不要提起。（invite a storm of protest at once，祈使句）
answers: In 1955 the clerk invited the whole class to the house for the whole place, and every applicant in the office said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three months on, the clerk still invites the whole class to the house without a word of thanks without being asked.
My mother said later that to invite the whole class to the house at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had invited the whole class to the house long before 1962, and the line in the file for May proves it.
Inviting the whole class to the house for the whole place, the clerk said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Invite a storm of protest at once at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 invite 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1955 the clerk invited the whole class to the house for the whole place, and nobody in the office forgot it.
Even now the clerk invites the whole class to the house without a word of thanks whenever the office asks.
Inviting the whole class to the house for the whole place, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever invite a storm of protest at once without a word of thanks, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new applicant from the next office invites a storm of protest at once for the whole place every month, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother invited the whole class to the house again, and the office remembered that half.
